added.statement: When an interactive Codex turn calls coordination_sweep, it shall send a session composed from the matching principal, the codex-agent role, and its stable thread identifier.
acceptance_criteria: Codex instructions name a thread-scoped direct-reader lane
The instructions do not direct the client to take over a foreign inbox

ears.response: use the thread-scoped direct-reader session with the matching principal

breaker.condition: the direct reader sends an unsuffixed or static shared session

added.statement: When the automatic Home Manager hook checks mail, it shall retain its isolated principal-hook session rather than sharing the direct-reader watermark.
acceptance_criteria: Codex instructions distinguish the thread-scoped direct reader from hook principal-hook
Existing hook tests still observe principal-hook

ears.precondition: both an interactive reader and a lifecycle hook exist
